description: Build the full public site (design §11/§16/§17/§18): shared UI primitives, reduced-motion baseline motion components, nav/footer/dynamic WhatsApp chrome, all home sections (Hero, About, Services, Industries, Work, Stats, Clients, Reviews, Team, Cta, Contact) as RSC reading the DAL, the contact form + submitContact server action (honeypot + rate limit), blog list/post with sanitized Markdown, work detail, branded 404, SEO (sitemap/robots/single-source OG), and the nice-to-have DiveField interactive hero. Depends on FEAT-001 + FEAT-002 (and uses the auth-free public path only). Independent of FEAT-003.
steps: Read context.json FIRST, then design.md §11 (public routes/pages), §16 (visual/motion + DiveField), §17 (SEO/OG), §18 (a11y), §13/§14 (contact validation/errors), and inspiration-notes.md (section order, typography, color, motion). All paths under datadive-web.

src/components/ui/*.tsx: Button, Card, Badge, Input, Textarea, Select, Container (max-w-7xl px-6), Section (py-24 md:py-32 + optional surface band), SectionHeading, Toast — focus-visible rings + AA contrast (these are reused by FEAT-005 admin).

src/components/motion/*.tsx: Reveal (IntersectionObserver fade/slide-up), CountUp (rAF 0->value, instant under reduced motion), GlowBlob (pure-CSS blurred radial gradient); wrap the app in <MotionConfig reducedMotion='user'>. All honor prefers-reduced-motion.

src/components/nav/*: Navbar (client, sticky, logo + data-driven NavLinks + CTA, mobile menu keyboard-operable with aria-expanded, focus-trapped, Esc-closes — FR-1.3); Footer (email/LinkedIn/website from settings); WhatsAppButton (client, builds wa.me/<digits>?text=, HIDDEN entirely when no number — FR-13.4, focusable + aria-label, reduced-motion entrance). Update src/app/layout.tsx to render Navbar+Footer+WhatsAppButton from getSettings()+getNavLinks().

src/components/sections/*.tsx + src/app/page.tsx: home sections as RSC reading DAL props, interactive bits as nested client components, in order Hero->About->Services->Industries->Work->Stats->Clients->Reviews->Team->Cta->Contact. Icon keys -> lucide via the mapper's §5.4/§5.7 mapping (Sparkles default). Services 2x2/4-up; Industries 5-up responsive; Work card grid where a card links to /work/[slug] ONLY when hasDetail (F6) -> mobile scroll-snap; Stats uses CountUp; Clients grouped by SectorGroup with name text fallback (FR-8.2); all images via next/image with alt. page.tsx sets export const revalidate=3600 and attaches all section tags + settings + nav.

src/components/sections/Contact.tsx + src/app/actions/contact.ts: ContactForm (client, react-hook-form + contact Zod schema, honeypot field, preserves values on error, inline field errors + aria-describedby). submitContact server action: server-side Zod validate -> honeypot silent-drop (200) -> per-IP in-memory token-bucket rate limit (<=5/min, friendly 429) -> createContactSubmission -> success/error result preserving values; best-effort email notify only if RESEND_API_KEY+CONTACT_NOTIFY_TO set (a send failure logs but never fails submission). No secrets/PII in client-visible errors.

Blog + work routes + Markdown: src/app/blog/page.tsx (published, reverse-chron by PublishDate, empty-state safe — FR-10); src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (generateStaticParams from getPublishedPostSlugs(), dynamicParams=true, per-post generateMetadata + OG/Twitter + canonical, notFound() on unknown/draft); src/app/work/[slug]/page.tsx (generateStaticParams from getProjectDetailSlugs(), notFound() when draft or empty Body — F6/F8); src/components/blog/Markdown.tsx (react-markdown + remark-gfm + rehype-sanitize — NFR-11.4); src/components/blog/PostCard.tsx.

SEO + 404: src/app/not-found.tsx (branded, home link — FR-1.6); src/app/sitemap.ts (/, /blog, each published post, each hasDetail project); src/app/robots.ts (allow all + sitemap); src/app/opengraph-image.tsx producing the generated brand-OG FALLBACK bytes only — generateMetadata.openGraph.images (Settings.OgImageUrl -> generated fallback) stays the single og:image source of truth (N4).

DiveField (NICE-TO-HAVE, FR-17 — must NOT jeopardize core delivery): src/components/motion/DiveField.tsx — decorative aria-hidden <canvas> behind the real hero headline/CTA, <=60 points, requestAnimationFrame, DPR-aware, PAUSED offscreen (IntersectionObserver) + when tab hidden (visibilitychange), pointer parallax via transforms only; on touch / prefers-reduced-motion render a static constellation. Mount in Hero. If it risks build/perf/layout, ship the hero with gradient glow only — no requirement fails.
Set FEAT-004 status to completed; in findings note the shared ui/ component APIs reused by admin and any section needing special admin wiring. Commit locally inside datadive-web (never push).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` + `npm run lint` pass with ZERO env vars.
`npm start` (zero env) renders / with every section populated from seed — no crashes, empty screens, or broken images; placeholders render through next/image.
/blog lists seed posts, a seed /blog/[slug] renders sanitized Markdown with per-post metadata, an unknown/draft slug 404s; a hasDetail seed /work/[slug] renders and a bodyless/draft slug 404s.
WhatsApp button builds a correct wa.me link from seed settings and hides when the number is empty; mobile nav is keyboard-operable, focus-trapped, Esc-closes.
`npx vitest run` passes the submitContact tests (honeypot drop, rate-limit trip, Airtable-failure retains values).
DiveField (if delivered) respects reduced motion / touch and does not regress the build; if cut, the hero still renders fully.
verification: cd datadive-web && npm run build && npm run lint  (zero env — must pass)
npm start then load / , /blog , a seed post, a seed project, and a bad slug (404)  (all render per spec from seed)
findings:
Delivered the full public site. Verification (zero env, in datadive-web): `npm run build` + `npm run lint` pass (18 routes prerendered); `npx vitest run` 95/95 pass incl. 5 new submitContact tests (honeypot silent-drop, validation no-write, rate-limit trip after 5/IP, Airtable-failure non-success result, success strips honeypot); `next start` live-probed — / 200 with every section populated from seed and all images via next/image (0 plain /seed tags), /blog 200, seed post 200, seed /work/hr-analytics-dashboard 200, bodyless /work/complaint-management-dashboard 404, unknown /blog slug 404, sitemap excludes the bodyless project, robots + /opengraph-image 200, wa.me link present from seed.

ESLINT CONFIG FIX (needed, not optional): .eslintrc.json used gitignore-style matching where the bare `airtable` pattern matched EVERY `@/lib/airtable/*` path, which blocked pages/actions/components from importing the DAL's own public read/write/mappers — contradicting design §3/§15 ('Go through the DAL (read|write)'). Refined to block only the Airtable client (`**/lib/airtable/client`, `@/lib/airtable/client`) via patterns and the `airtable` npm package via an exact `paths` entry. Boundary intent preserved: network/secrets stay in src/lib/airtable/client; read/write/mappers remain the typed public surface.

SHARED ui/ APIs REUSED BY ADMIN (FEAT-005), all in src/components/ui/ (barrel src/components/ui/index.ts): Button + buttonVariants({variant:'primary'|'secondary'|'outline'|'ghost'|'danger', size:'sm'|'md'|'lg', className}) (forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement>; use buttonVariants on next/link CTAs); Card({accent?:Accent, interactive?}) forwardRef<HTMLDivElement>; Badge({tone:'neutral'|'brand'|'amber'|'green'|'red'}); Input({invalid?}) / Textarea({invalid?, rows}) / Select({invalid?}) — all forwardRef and react-hook-form register-ready (spread {...register(name)}); Container({as?, className}) = max-w-7xl px-6; Section({id?, surface?, bleed?}) = py-24 md:py-32; SectionHeading({eyebrow?, title, subtitle?, align:'left'|'center'}); Toast ('use client'; {tone:'success'|'error', message, onDismiss?}) controlled, role=status aria-live=polite. Plus cn() at @/lib/utils/cn and formatDate() at @/lib/utils/date. Motion: MotionProvider (wraps app in <MotionConfig reducedMotion='user'>), Reveal/CountUp/GlowBlob/DiveField in src/components/motion (all honor prefers-reduced-motion).

ADMIN WIRING NOTES: (1) The submitContact result shape — {ok:true} | {ok:false, code:'validation', fieldErrors} | {code:'rate-limit'|'error', message} — is the template for admin action results; map fieldErrors to react-hook-form setError and show Toast. (2) Admin EntityForm should reuse Input/Textarea/Select/Button with each entity's Zod schema (src/lib/validation); the admin ImageField should pair optionalImageUrlSchema with a required alt Input when a URL is present. (3) src/components/blog/Markdown.tsx renders rehype-sanitized Markdown — reuse for admin body previews. (4) SEO single-source helpers live in src/lib/seo.ts (resolveSiteUrl, ogImageUrl, buildOpenGraph) — admin OgImageUrl flows through ogImageUrl(). (5) DiveField shipped in full (canvas, paused offscreen/tab-hidden, static constellation on touch/reduced-motion) and did not regress the build; it is purely decorative (aria-hidden) and can be dropped from Hero with zero requirement impact.
